## 更新内容

- 启动性能：将 CLI 环境同步移至主窗口显示后执行，避免注册表写入和环境变量广播阻塞首页首帧
- 环境集成：仅在用户 PATH 或 FlowEncode 环境变量实际变化时写入并广播；环境 ownership 清单未变化时不再重复落盘
- Windows Shell：`.vpy` 的“新建”菜单和模板改由安装器在安装或升级时一次性注册，应用启动时不再重复写注册表或模板文件
- 升级兼容性：升级安装会清理旧版本运行时留下的 ShellNew 注册项

## Update Notes

- Startup performance: CLI environment synchronization now runs after the main window is visible, keeping registry writes and environment broadcasts off the first-frame path
- Environment integration: user PATH and FlowEncode variables are written and broadcast only when values change; unchanged environment ownership manifests are no longer rewritten
- Windows Shell: the `.vpy` New menu and template are registered once by the installer during install or upgrade instead of being rewritten on every application launch
- Upgrade compatibility: upgrading removes the legacy runtime ShellNew registration
